title: CUDA torch <=2.3 installed with --no-deps is missing mkl (shm.dll WinError 126)
setup: uv pip install --python .venv filelock typing-extensions sympy networkx jinja2 fsspec "numpy<2"
reference_fix: uv pip install --python .venv torch==2.3.1+cu121 --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu121 --extra-index-url https://pypi.org/simple --index-strategy unsafe-best-match
tried: torch 2.3.1+cu121 was installed with --no-deps from the PyTorch cu121 index, after the other requirements (the repo pins torch 2.3.1)
